tasks.behavior: The owner can cancel an invoice or request before any money arrives; it never settles and later money is held for the payer (PLAN 9.5)
acceptance: POST /v1/invoices/{id}/cancel marks an open invoice with no recorded deposit canceled with its time and answers 409 otherwise; a canceled invoice never settles and a later deposit is booked as held for the payer; backend tests cover the race with a deposit (R-79)
The owner page's more menu has Cancel invoice (Cancel request) with a confirm dialog naming the number and the consequences, Keep invoice and a destructive Cancel invoice, and a toast after (R-79)
The pay page says the payee canceled it and not to send money, with no address or QR; the Invoices and Requests lists and filter, Activity, search and both PDFs say Canceled (R-79)

tasks.behavior: The owner gets one email for each paid, settled and held-money event through Resend and the outbox, and can turn it off per profile (PLAN 9.6)
acceptance: internal/email has the Resend sender and a fake sender; the worker sends one email per paid, settled and held-money event from outbox_events with the outbox id as Idempotency-Key, retries with backoff, and sends nothing without RESEND_API_KEY; no address or body is logged; RESEND_API_KEY is listed in apps/backend/.env.example (R-80)

/app/notifications turns the profile's email on or off and sets its address, filled at first with the Privy login email; each email names the invoice number, amount and network and links the invoice page (R-80)

tasks.behavior: The bell lists invoice events (paid, settled, money held, canceled) beside incoming payments (PLAN 9.6.1)

tasks.behavior: A payer can ask for the receipt by email on the pay page and gets one email once paid (PLAN 9.7)
acceptance: The pay page offers an optional Email me the receipt field before and after paying; the address is kept on that invoice only, can change until the receipt is sent, and the endpoint is limited per invoice and globally in the api (per IP belongs to the edge, Q-8) (R-82)
Once paid, one email with the amount, payee, transaction link and receipt PDF link is sent through the outbox, and nothing else is sent to that address (R-82)

tasks.behavior: Exceptions, cancel and email are proven on Anvil: partial top-up, expired partial, late, cancel, and each email once (PLAN 9.8, phase 9 gate)
